query: For my 63‑year‑old female patient: among females 58–68 with hemorrhagic stroke and COPD exacerbation, what's the hospital LOS IQR?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY los) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY los)) AS interquartile_range FROM icustays;
